annotations.title: Analyse a technology or research field

description: A landscape of a technology or research field from open research data: an opportunity score (0-100) with its reasons, momentum, lab-to-market gap and geographic concentration; works per year and growth stage; industry participation and the top companies; key researchers, institutions, countries and funders; rising sub-topics, standout recent work and related patents. Several fields come back ranked. For written opportunities, use the field-opportunity-analysis prompt. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/innovation-radar on your Apify account (about $0.03 per field; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

fields.description: Fields or technologies, e.g. "solid state battery", "CRISPR base editing".

years.description: Years of history for the trend.

name: analyze_field

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Analyse a technology or research field
